name.en: Radiation transport and moment methods

note.ja: 主検証は1997型の輻射輸送・物質交換です。熱・拡散方程式への関連は、別の周期Fourier制御におけるE約V、拡散係数1/[3κ(ε+1)]の極限に限ります。1996Marshak境界や輸送全体の厳密解とは区別します。 全方向の風上FVとSSPRK2でIとVを実進行。I=2U、E=半角積分、εE+Vの収支を追跡し、拡散への置換はしません。 厚い極限制御だけは同じ風上演算子を実cos/sin応答から構成し、単一モードを行列指数で時間厳密に進めます。
note.en: The main benchmark uses1997-type radiation/material transport. The heat equation is a limiting companion for separate periodic Fourier controls with E approximately V and diffusivity1/[3kappa(epsilon+1)],not the1996Marshak boundary problem or an exact solution of full transport. Full signed-angle upwind FV/SSPRK2 advancesIandV. WithI=2U,E=halfangularintegral,the weightedbudgetisepsilonE+V;nodiffusionsubstitution. Only the thick-limit control constructs the same upwind operator from actual real cos/sin responses and evolves one Fourier mode by an exact-time matrix exponential.

note.ja: 2D空間と3D角度測度、c1、静止吸収体。実S_Nと非線形M1を24/48/96格子で進め、同一solverの変動方向MMS・x/y交差packet controlを保持。 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
note.en: Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets. Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

note.en: The main benchmark uses1997-type radiation/material transport. The heat equation is a limiting companion for separate periodic Fourier controls with E approximately V and diffusivity1/[3kappa(epsilon+1)],not the1996Marshak boundary problem or an exact solution of full transport. Fiveprimaryrunsseparatespace,32/64angles,timeandindependentW/Verrors. Finite/causalzero/homogeneousanalyticsource normalization oftheprovidedtableswerequalifiedbeforemain. name.ja: Su–Olson輸送：2023著者公開の独立解析ベンチマーク表
name.en: Su–Olson transport: primary2023author-provided analytical benchmark data

note.ja: 主検証は1997型の輻射輸送・物質交換です。熱・拡散方程式への関連は、別の周期Fourier制御におけるE約V、拡散係数1/[3κ(ε+1)]の極限に限ります。1996Marshak境界や輸送全体の厳密解とは区別します。 有限格子の数値参照 無限領域の対称1次元角度輸送と物質交換で、ε=1、弾性散乱なし、低温の零初期状態です。Q=1を|x|<0.5、0<τ<10に与えます。主計算は左反射・十分遠い右入射真空の半領域で、比較時刻は境界の影響前です。別の同条件比較用の周期セル平均制御は、物理座標x∈[0,2π)、c=ε=1、κ=4/8/16、N=128/512/2048、Q=0、初期I=V=1+0.1cos(x)、s=0/.0625/.125/.25に対するt=κsを用います。この制御は1997のsource駆動問題とは初期・境界・sourceが異なり、制御内のFV・連続角度参照・拡散比較に同じ入力を用います。 原1997本文・原表と直接照合したとはしません。公開表の転記か再生成かは著者READMEに未記載。source停止後、一般散乱、全時空間の連続体誤差や角度次数は未認証です。 この追加はκhを解像したN∝κ²の半離散周期制御で、固定格子AP性や主SSPRK2の拡散時間次数を認証しません。初期F0と非零Fick流束の初期層を保持し、極限判定は最終s=.25のみ。両行列伝播にSciPy sparse expm_multiplyを共有し、DOP853照合は参照伝播器の資格です。
note.en: The main benchmark uses1997-type radiation/material transport. The heat equation is a limiting companion for separate periodic Fourier controls with E approximately V and diffusivity1/[3kappa(epsilon+1)],not the1996Marshak boundary problem or an exact solution of full transport. Finite-grid numerical reference Infinite symmetric1D angular transport/material exchange,epsilon1,no elastic scattering,cold initial state. Source Q1 for |x|<.5 and0<tau<10. Primary half-domain uses reflecting left and distant incoming-vacuum right; comparison times precede boundary influence. A separate matched periodic cell-mean companion uses physical x in [0,2*pi), c=epsilon=1, kappa4/8/16, N128/512/2048, Q0, initial I=V=1+.1cos(x), and t=kappa*s for s=0,.0625,.125,.25. Its IC/BC/source differ from the source-driven1997 benchmark; the FV, continuum-angular and diffusion comparisons within this companion use matched inputs. No direct original1997fulltext/tablecomparison claim. TheauthorREADMEdoesnotstate transcriptionversusregeneration. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator.

The independent characteristic cell averages and manufactured M1 forcing passed191reference/component checks before any PDE main. note.ja: 2D空間と3D角度測度、c1、静止吸収体。実S_Nと非線形M1を24/48/96格子で進め、同一solverの変動方向MMS・x/y交差packet controlを保持。 解析解 2D空間に3D角度測度を用い、c=1の軸に整列した光線を扱います。実際の符号付き角度輸送と非線形の閉じたM1方程式をともに進めます。解析特性線の参照はRTE/S_Nに適用し、M1解全体の厳密参照とはしません。 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
note.en: Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets. Analytic reference 2Dspace with3Dangular measure,c1. Pure aligned rays; actual signed-angle transport and nonlinear closed M1 both evolved. The analytic characteristic reference applies to RTE/S_N,not to the entire M1 solution. Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented.
